cascade shape generalizes to the mixer class, or whether Tornado's cross-layer reaction was

- Bitcoin-only (no asset_onchain layer, no ETH PBS-relay analogue)
- Pre-Merge (no L1 Ethereum infrastructure existed yet)
- Operator-run mixer service, not a smart-contract protocol
- Centralized domain operator who could physically shut the service down

landing page within 10 days of designation. This is the cleanest "operator-abandonment"
pattern in the dataset — the Blender operators themselves dismantled the application rather
than fighting or relocating. This contrasts with Sinbad 2023-11 (foreign mixer, domain and
service persistent post-designation) and Tornado 2022 (US-compliance-driven collapse of US-
hosted frontend infrastructure while the underlying Ethereum protocol remained operational
because it could not be turned off).

currency address enumeration — instead, an industry-class banking severance.

comparison shape: nation-state regulator cuts banking rails rather than targeting

natural comparison candidate for future addition.

the banking-service severance as the regulatory mandate).
